# Known-answer test (KAT) conformance report

<!-- GENERATED by assurance/kat/run.mjs. Do not edit by hand; re-run the command. -->

**Scope.** Selected published known-answer vectors run against the cryptographic primitives the product calls (Node.js `node:crypto` / WebCrypto backed by OpenSSL, and the laboratory-only `@noble/post-quantum` provider). This is engineering conformance evidence only. It is **not** CAVP/ACVP algorithm validation, **not** FIPS 140-3 module validation and **not** SAG evaluation; none of those is held.

## Failure-mode checks

Deterministic negative tests: each must be rejected (or, for KEM implicit rejection, yield a different shared secret).

| Algorithm | Check | Status | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AES-256-GCM | control: unmodified ciphertext decrypts to the original plaintext | **PASS** | round trip exact |
| AES-256-GCM | corrupted tag (last byte flipped) | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | corrupted ciphertext (first byte flipped) | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | wrong key (one bit differs) | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | truncated ciphertext (last byte removed) | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | truncated below tag length (15 bytes) | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | wrong additional data | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| AES-256-GCM | wrong IV | **PASS** | rejected (OperationError) |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | control (WebCrypto): valid signature verifies | **PASS** | accepted |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | modified message (WebCrypto) | **PASS** | rejected |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | modified signature (s bit flipped) (WebCrypto) | **PASS** | rejected |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | wrong public key (WebCrypto) | **PASS** | rejected |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | public key not on curve (WebCrypto) | **PASS** | rejected |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | control (node:crypto): valid signature verifies | **PASS** | accepted |
| ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 | modified message (node:crypto) | **PASS** | rejected |

## What this does not show

- Vector coverage is the subset listed above; NOT-RUN rows are gaps, not passes.
- Passing KATs on OpenSSL-backed Node.js says nothing about a FIPS 140-3 module boundary, self-tests, or operational environment (see `docs/assurance/fips-sag-gap-analysis.md`).
- Laboratory PQC providers are excluded from releases (`packages/pqc-lab`); their KAT results do not make them deployable.
